_note: Box types. 'hidden' boxes aren't sold in the shop (the tutorial box: what your first two pets come from, only commons). 'tiers' are weights for each part's rarity roll, 'finishes' for the finish roll, 'traits' for how many traits (index = count). 'capsules' is the price in the capsule machine's plain capsules (x Machine.coin_value, shown in coins), so boxes keep up with the machine. 'art' colours the pack (the shop sticker and the one you rip open). 'reserve' is what your pet keeps when it buys boxes itself, in the same capsules (so it keeps up too): where it starts, the step of the boxes tab's -/+ and the settings slider's top.
